xrefdescription.para: WSR-01: Single transient failure — retry succeeds on second attempt.
WSR-02: Two consecutive failures — succeeds on third attempt.
WSR-03: Three consecutive failures — returns failure after exhausting retries.
WSR-04: Exponential backoff intervals are strictly increasing (1×, 2×, 4× base).
WSR-05: Total retry duration stays within configured max_retry_time budget.
WSR-06: Successful first attempt records zero retries.
WSR-07: Jitter mode produces non-deterministic intervals (variance > 0 across 10 independent runs with different seeds).
WSR-08: Retry is only triggered for retryable codes; kFatal and kInvalidArg must fail immediately without retrying.
WSR-09: Concurrent retry sessions do not interfere (2 threads × 8 retries each, all must reach kOk).
WSR-10: Retry counter is reset after a successful request.
WSR-11: Zero-retry config returns immediately on first failure.
WSR-12: Max-retries=1 allows exactly one retry attempt.
WSR-13: Retry callback is invoked exactly once per retry attempt.
WSR-14: Request metadata (headers, body) is preserved across retries.

detaileddescription.para: The callable receives its metadata on every attempt — simulating that the retry gate re-sends the original request unchanged.

xrefdescription.para: WSR-15: Retry logic converts callable exceptions into fatal results.
WSR-16: Retry gate self-check — passes when all 16 WSR assertions are satisfied. Counter must equal 1.0.
HST-01: Request exceeding deadline is cancelled and returns kTimedOut.
HST-02: Request completing within deadline succeeds normally.
HST-03: Zero-timeout config rejects immediately.
HST-04: Graceful shutdown drains in-flight requests before terminating.
HST-05: New connections rejected after shutdown is initiated.
HST-06: Idle connections are closed within configured idle_timeout.

detaileddescription.para: Modelled by verifying that the configured idle_timeout is non-zero and that a connection inactive longer than idle_timeout would be recycled.

xrefdescription.para: HST-07: Active connection is not forcibly closed during graceful shutdown window.
HST-08: Shutdown completes within configured max_shutdown_duration.
HST-09: Multiple concurrent timeout requests complete without deadlock.
HST-10: Timeout does not leak resources (in-flight counter returns to zero after timed-out request).
HST-11: Keepalive timeout recycles connection after inactivity.
HST-12: Shutdown gate self-check — counter = 1.0 when all 12 HST assertions pass.

briefdescription.para: Server Module Hardening — Phase 5 focused regression tests.

detaileddescription.para: Covers two acceptance-criteria tracks from NEXT_PHASE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md (P5-S01 and P5-S02) and src/server/ROADMAP.md Phase 5:

listitem.para: WSR (P5-S01): Wire-protocol retry with exponential backoff (16 tests)
HST (P5-S02): HTTP timeout + graceful shutdown semantics (12 tests)

detaileddescription.para: All infrastructure is fully in-process; no real TCP ports are opened. State machines drive retry/timeout/shutdown lifecycles using std::chrono::steady_clock and std::atomic so the suite is deterministic and portable.
Seed 42 (kCanonicalSeed) is used wherever reproducible randomness is required (jitter, concurrent scheduling).
